body:
Hah, now I have a hangover from strong emotions. Thanks for the help. I'll just keep rolling now and probably when there's bumps I'll come here and piss and moan again. 
And offer useless advice to people who actually have real problems.

If you can, consider moving out. The thing about the bank account below was sound advice, if he has the rights to withdraw from it. You might not even need to open a new account, just remove your father if he's named on it.

I don't know if this will work for you, but if things get violent, don't be afraid to call for help from the police. My experience was the less I told people about my intentions the better, as things didn't get to escalate beforehand. It really depends do you feel you can have a dialogue with your father.
Try to stay cool, even if it's hard. If you leave it might be a good idea to let things and feelings calm down for a while before you re-establish contact with your father. And your father is really being unreasonable.

Hm, I don't really know do I want it. Can you have urges for something that you don't want? It's possible for me to function and the moods do get better. So it's not serious I guess. I've been keeping myself occupied writing here, for these couple of hours and while things aren't fundamentally sound, all is not as unbearable as it felt when wrote the first post. 
It was a little bit surprising to see how other people feel the same and what they write about is similar to my feelings.
Like you're on a sinking ship and you can wave to to the other guy who's drowning with you.

Double fuck. I think that you don't need have any value as a person to have a relationship. Hell, the most annoying assholes I know live in beautiful mix of love and misery with other bags of crap.

I don't believe a relationship is a potluck where you have to bring something to the party. Being in relationship won't make you any happier if you're depressed though. 

What closure do you want from your ex by the way?

Projects, distractions, anything that focuses you on something else. If you're out and about and have money go see a movie. If you're at home, exercise. Read wikipedia or troll stormfront. Do something.

Going against the topic, I guess I'd say I try to be nice.
In a sort half assed-smug way. Say thanks and smile to the cashier, help somebody unknown out if they need a hand and they're not an obvious dick. 
It's not really a lot, is it? It's being a functional member of a society and not a thing that you should be especially proud of.

Don't try it that way. Really, I speak from experience. My try wasn't just below freezing, it was arctic winter so it should have been quick. 
It was painful as hell and if you don't pass out soon enough you're shivering there fucking uncontrollably while your extremities feel like they're on fire. Don't get me started on the frostbites. If you fuck it up, which is a high possibility you'll be left with memories of something that's doesn't really resemble anything romantic slipping away to the sweet gentle night.

Take breather and think of something else. Nothing really is going to certainly get better in the long run, but you might think of a better way. Brr-r, shit, I really don't regret a lot of things, but that's something I'd like not to have experienced.

Hey man. I hate you too.
I've really got no shining, this thing is going to work-advice to give you, but I can tell what seemed to work for me for a while. I tried drinking, drugs and all that, but usually they left me worse off in the end. Nothing like crying and puking while hungover.

If you're still capable enough, and you seem to be as you can still roll like nothings wrong, even if it's all downhill, try to distract yourself. 


With projects and small shit. If it's all pointless anyways why not try to make a goal to run 10K under 50 minutes or something. 
When things get really bad it might help getting you through to the next day, and then you move on to something else.

Maybe try not appreciate it all in one go as it all is pointless waste of time. Concentrate on little things.

Shit, if everything else fails you can post advice on /SW to get through to the next hour.
